title: Azmi and the Unlit Lantern
logline: Azmi tries to give light to Nour and learns you can only share a flame you carry.
story: Nour, who was light (the city's intrinsic light), lived in fear of the dark, and Azmi, who carried spirited resolve, arrived with a grand offer of light. But Azmi's own lantern was cold, kept only for show. However many times Azmi pressed the dead lamp into Nour's hands, no warmth would pass. Only when Azmi stopped to kindle a true flame within did the smallest glow leap, at last, from one wick to the other. Azmi learned that light is never given from an empty hand.
moral: You cannot give a light you have not first kindled within yourself.
